messages.subject: course presentation of robustness/sensitivity analysis
messages.body_plain:
If you’re interested in learning about robustness analysis/sensitivity, come “stop by” either on zoom or in person.

April 1, 3, 1pm-2:15pm (eastern)  on zoom and room 275 Giltner at MSU

On Monday April 1 we will be working from:

powerpoint for replacement of cases <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/quantifying%20the%20robustness%20of%20causal%20inferences%20replacement%20of%20cases%202.pptx> [pdf of replacement of cases] <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/quantifying%20the%20robustness%20of%20causal%20inferences%20replacement%20of%20cases.pdf>

On Wednesday April 3 we will be working from:

powerpoint for correlation framework <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/quantifying%20the%20robustness%20of%20causal%20inferences%20for%20regression.pptx> [pdf of correlation framework] <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/quantifying%20the%20robustness%20of%20causal%20inferences%20for%20regression.pdf>

quick examples <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/Quick%20Examples%20of%20Quantifying%20the%20Robustness%20to%20Invalidate.pptx> [pdf of quick examples] <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/Quick%20Examples%20of%20Quantifying%20the%20Robustness%20to%20Invalidate.pdf>

To participate on zoom you will click on https://msu.zoom.us/j/783760435.  Download for 2 minutes and you will be ready.  I will start the zoom session at the time of the meeting.  Or you can call in at (415) 762-9988 or (646) 568-7788. Meeting ID is 783-760-435.

Please do not engage zoom more than a few minutes before our meeting as I may be in another Zoom meeting.  Thanks

Check out the R Shiny app for sensitivity analysis

http://konfound-it.com.

R Shiny app KonFound-it <https://msu.edu/~kenfrank/Konfound%20it%20R%20shiny%20announce.pdf>

Ken Frank

MSU Foundation Professor of Sociometrics
